name: Bang bang prawn salad
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical BBC Good Food / similar prawn noodle salad recipes (200g prawns + 140g dry noodles for 2 adult servings).
Preparation time estimated from instructions (noodle cooking ~3-5 min + sauce melting ~2-3 min + assembly ~5 min; total active ~15 min).
Peanut butter classified as containing peanuts (allergen true) and incompatible with Vegan/Vegetarian.
Prawns classified as shellfish (allergen true) and incompatible with Vegetarian/Vegan.
Sweet chilli sauce assumed to contain no wheat/soy/sesame (common formulations vary; left ambiguous).
Rice noodles assumed rice-only (no wheat); gluten-free left null due to possible cross-contamination or uncertified status.
Coconut milk, cucumber, bean sprouts, spring onions compatible with all listed diets.
No milk, eggs, fish, tree nuts, or sesame explicitly present.
instructions:
step 1
Cook the noodles following pack instructions, then rinse under cold water and drain thoroughly. In a small saucepan melt together the peanut butter, coconut milk, sweet chilli sauce and half the spring onions, adding 1-2 tbsp of water to loosen the mixture to a drizzling consistency.

step 2
Mix the noodles, cucumber and beansprouts in a serving dish. Top with the prawns, drizzle over the peanut sauce and scatter over the remaining spring onions.

ingredients.name: Rice Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: Dry rice noodles as per pack; typical Asian vermicelli-style values used.

ingredients.name: Peanut Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Smooth peanut butter; 1 tbsp ≈ 16 g, standard nutritional profile.

ingredients.name: Coconut Milk
ingredients.assumptions: Canned coconut milk; 1 tbsp ≈ 15 g, full-fat standard values.

ingredients.name: sweet chilli sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Sweet chilli sauce; 1 tbsp ≈ 15 g, typical sugar-heavy profile.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium spring onions, total edible weight ≈ 45 g after trimming.

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium-large cucumber, edible flesh and skin ≈ 300 g after slicing.

ingredients.name: Bean Sprouts
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh bean sprouts, standard mung bean values.

ingredients.name: Prawns
ingredients.assumptions: Cooked prawns (shrimp), peeled and ready-to-eat weight.
